Container.Name: kidtube
Container.Overview: colors: a self-hosted kids' video app. Approved YouTube downloads, Plex shows, time limits. Parents' page on the web port.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Parents' page and the TV app's API

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, settings, cookies file, your own characters (characters/*.svg)

Config.Name: Admin password (first run)
Config.Description: Sets the parents' password on first start if none is set yet. Ignored after that.

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: Optional. Read-only use: listing and streaming allowed titles.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for day rollover and closed hours

Config.Name: PO token helper
Config.Description: Optional but recommended: a bgutil-ytdlp-pot-provider container (e.g. http://[IP]:4416), so YouTube doesn't take the server for a bot. Its tag must match the plugin version in server/requirements.txt.
